used_propositions: Commercial notes state that Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH and that Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
Registry row HRB 88421 lists the registered company name as Oakfield Logistik GmbH with status active in Germany.
Billing records show billed_name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
support_claim: Commercial notes, registry records, and billing data jointly tie the billing referent Oakfield Logistik GmbH to Handelsregister HRB 88421 as the same active legal entity.
